title: Barbra Streisand - A Happening In Central Park - 8-Track Tape Cartridge Columbia
descriptionText: The product is an 8-track tape cartridge of Barbra Streisand's album "A Happening In Central Park" released by Columbia. This vintage music format allows listeners to enjoy Streisand's easy listening genre in the convenience of playing it on an 8-track player. The release title provides a glimpse into the musical journey of one of the most iconic artists of her time, offering a nostalgic and unique listening experience for music enthusiasts.
